what: Static 3D miniatures for the SRD 5.2.1 goblins of the general pool: a goblin warrior (drawn for both goblin_warrior and goblin_minion; the minion smaller and paler in the scene) and the goblin boss.
made: 2026-11-17, for this prototype, at the maintainer's request (second figure batch, approved 2026-11-17).
design: Original, generic fantasy goblins drawn from the SRD 5.2.1 stat blocks (templates/rulesets/5e-2024/npcs/goblin_{minion,warrior,boss}.yml): the warrior in leather armour with scimitar, shortbow and quiver, a buckler on its back and two daggers on its belt (the minion's daggers); the boss stockier, in a chain shirt and wolf-fur mantle with an iron half-helm, scimitar, shortbow and a shield on its back. Not modelled on any game's, film's or book's goblins; no third-party asset.
pipeline: Reference images: ChatGPT image generation (Codex's built-in image_gen tool) through OpenAI Codex CLI 0.161.0 on the maintainer's ChatGPT subscription. One full-body front view per figure with the undead skeleton's front view as the style reference (so the goblins match the heroes and undead), then a matching back view generated from that front.

Meshes: Tripo API v3 multiview-to-model (front + back), model v3.1-20260211, standard geometry, detailed PBR texture, 40 credits each, on the maintainer's Tripo API account. Every first result was kept.

Web copies: Blender 5.2.3, 3d-models/tools/normalize_glb.py --weld: join the glTF UV-seam splits, decimate to 30k triangles (one closed mesh, ready for rigging), textures to 1024 px WebP, rotate 90 degrees (Tripo faces +X) to face glTF -Z, scale to the listed height, centre, feet at y=0.
style_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, image-to-3D full-body character reference for a small figure in a tabletop-miniature style fantasy game. Original generic fantasy design, not based on any existing game, film, book, franchise or brand.
Style: polished stylized 3D game-character render with hand-painted textures, like a high-quality stylized fantasy tabletop miniature: chunky readable silhouette, simplified clean forms, slightly enlarged head, hands and feet, muted desaturated palette, soft clay-like shading, crisp material separation.
View and pose: strict front view (orthographic-looking, camera at chest height), the character faces directly toward the viewer, symmetric neutral A-pose: upright, feet planted shoulder-width apart, both arms held down and slightly away from the body (about 20 degrees) so background is visible between each arm and the torso, fingers relaxed. Anything held in the hands points straight down and stays close to the leg.
Framing: exactly one character, the entire figure (head to feet, all held items) fully inside the portrait frame with generous white margin on all sides.
Background: pure white, soft even studio lighting, only a faint contact shadow under the feet. No base, plinth, ground plane, scenery, smoke, particles, text, letters, logo, watermark, signature, border, or extra characters or objects.
sources: Reference images and prompts: assets/goblins/source/<kind>/ (tracked). Codex logs, raw Tripo model.glb and task.json: the same folders, untracked (copied from <repo-root>). Credit log: ../heroes/source/LEDGER.txt (local).
rights: Generated with the maintainer's own accounts under the OpenAI and Tripo terms that applied at the time; no third-party asset is included. Re-check those terms before any redistribution outside this game.
runtime: frontend/figure-models.js (FIGURE_MODELS goblin and goblin_boss; FIGURE_VARIANTS maps goblin_warrior and goblin_minion to the goblin mesh); served only at the exact paths in webgame.app.GOBLIN_MODEL_FILES.

models.placement: faces -Z (glTF), feet at y=0, centred on the vertical axis
models.textures: base colour, normal and occlusion-roughness-metallic, 1024 px WebP

references.subject: Subject: a goblin warrior (monster), a small, wiry, hunched humanoid about two thirds of a human's height with a slightly oversized head, long pointed ears angled out and back, a sharp nose, a wide mouth with small sharp teeth, narrow yellow eyes, mottled olive-green skin and a few tufts of coarse dark hair. It wears scuffed brown leather armour (a padded leather jerkin with simple shoulder pieces) over a ragged undyed tunic, a leather belt with two small sheathed daggers, short frayed trousers, cloth leg wraps and bare clawed feet. A small round wooden buckler with an iron rim is strapped flat on its back, and a short leather quiver with a few arrows hangs at its right hip. In its right hand (on viewer-left) it holds a short curved scimitar pointing straight down beside its right leg without touching it; in its left hand (on viewer-right) it holds a small wooden shortbow, string facing the leg, pointing straight down beside its left leg. Generic fantasy goblin, not resembling any game's goblins.

references.subject: Subject: a goblin boss (monster), the chieftain of a goblin band: a small but broad, scarred, self-assured goblin, slightly taller and much stockier than an ordinary goblin, with a large head, long notched pointed ears with a few small brass rings, a sharp hooked nose, a wide grinning mouth with small sharp teeth, narrow yellow eyes and mottled olive-green skin. It wears a riveted steel chain shirt over a dark red padded tunic, a shaggy grey wolf-fur mantle over its shoulders, a battered iron half-helm with a short ragged red plume, a wide leather belt with a big iron buckle and a pouch, dark leather trousers, cloth leg wraps and bare clawed feet. A round iron-rimmed wooden shield painted dark red is strapped flat on its back, with a quiver of arrows beside it. In its right hand (on viewer-left) it holds a short curved scimitar pointing straight down beside its right leg without touching it; in its left hand (on viewer-right) it holds a small wooden shortbow, string facing the leg, pointing straight down beside its left leg. Generic fantasy goblin, not resembling any game's goblins.
